comment: WITHHELD UNTIL DISCLOSURE. The private oracle deck's copy of the withheld step set, and its reason. This directory holds the private deck's recorded probe dumps for the FULL 70-step op list; every dump from step 20 on carries the content the withheld steps store. The withheld step numbers and reasons are the ones in reference-harness/fixtures/write-battery-v1/withheld/steps.json — this file records that the same three steps apply to this recording. A release package excludes this directory.

steps.label: update with unsafe html
steps.why: Withheld: stores the probe's unsafe markup on an existing card and records what Ruby's content cleaner keeps.

steps.label: create plain text with html
steps.why: Withheld: creates a card whose content is the probe's unsafe markup, the second arm of the same gap.

steps.label: revert to previous of a create (trashes it)
steps.why: Withheld: reverts the step 22 create, so its recorded revert content is the withheld step 22 content.
